scope: Source commit inventory; pending rows require semantic review.

statusDefinitions.ported-reviewed: See compatibility ledgers for adaptations and tests.
statusDefinitions.partially-ported: Only the stated source portions are integrated; remaining behavior is not claimed.
statusDefinitions.target-files-identical: All touched file blobs match target, including matching deletions. Tree evidence does not independently verify behavior.
statusDefinitions.needs-disposition: Path differences alone do not establish a missing feature or incompatibility.
